description: Recent finished runs of a project or AI process, newest first, with a summary: how long the command usually takes (median of successful runs), how often it succeeds, and how long it takes to start listening on its port. Use it when the user asks how long a build or script usually takes, whether it has been failing, or what happened on recent runs. Only finished runs are recorded; use get_status for whether it is running now. Commands are shown as recorded, with secret values masked as ***.

id.description: Project or AI process ID (from list_projects)

limit.description: How many recent runs to list (default 10, max 50).

name: get_run_history
title: Get a project's run history
